raidjit live kernel explorer

raidjit is a JIT compiler that generates optimized machine code for RAID erasure coding (encoding, recovery, parity update) on x86-64, AArch64, and RISC-V. This page compiles kernels live in your browser: pick an ISA, topology, and operation below, then optionally pin kernel variants ("twins") to compare the generated assembly and cost-model estimates. uops/byte is a static-model estimate of per-byte cost, not a measured benchmark — lower is better when comparing variants of the same kernel. Nothing here is executed: compilation only, no benchmarking.
